title: 3DO DevBench — Dashboard
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: Status pills
items.text: Run mode (running / paused), guest frame counter and CPU state (running, or HALTED in red at a breakpoint).

items.label: Run controls
items.text: Run (real time), Turbo, Pause, +1 frame / +60, CPU halt (debugger freeze), Reset and Reboot for the selected session.

items.label: Tabs
items.text: Dashboard, Screen, OS, Debug, Memory, Console and API.

items.label: Sessions
items.text: pid, disc, control and gdb ports and whether it has a desktop window; select makes it current, stop ends it.

items.label: Start a session
items.text: Pick a disc, optional desktop window, running or paused (stepped by scripts/agents) and the BIOS (MCP: emu_boot).

items.label: OS summary
items.text: Read straight from the 3DO kernel in guest RAM: KernelBase, current task, live items vs the item table, DRAM/VRAM in use, items per type (MCP: os_overview).

items.label: Projects
items.text: Every project in projects/ with build (compiler output below), run (session on its ISO) and test (its test.py).
